description: The record of the state layer: which kind of state lives where, with a state map listing every piece, its home and the reason.
A table of every piece of state with its kind, home and reason. It exposes duplicates and makes reviews concrete.
The single owner of a value. Server data is owned by the server; the client holds a cache, never a second copy in a store.
The anti-pattern of putting state in a store before a distant consumer exists. The client store should hold only client-owned state read far apart.
A process whose steps have rules (no double payment, no going back while confirming). A state machine encodes the rules as allowed transitions.
